method: Open web search across Helius's declared buyer segments. Two signals were fetched and read in full; the rest are search-sourced and say so. None of these clears the pipeline's grounding bar - they are research starters.

signals.quote: matching engines that have to be fast and correct, market data pipelines measured in microseconds ... Solana programs, transaction pipelines ... latency budgets, profiling, throughput ceilings, p99 tail work
signals.verified: FETCHED - read in full; role open until 2026-12-19
signals.counter: A job advert describes what they are building, not what they will buy. They may intend to build this in-house - that is what the posting literally says they are hiring for.
signals.route: the hiring manager named on the posting

signals.quote: Trading is expected to begin in early 2027 ... selected Solana for reliability, speed, low cost and established track record
signals.verified: FETCHED - press release read in full
signals.counter: A regulated venue 14 months from launch may already have an infrastructure partner, and an SEC notice is an intention, not a build.
signals.route: Christopher Montagano, President - named in their own release; title unconfirmed as current

signals.quote: off-chain matching engine and order book with on-chain settlement
signals.verified: SEARCH ONLY - not read from a Pacifica-owned page
signals.counter: Top of the volume table usually means an infrastructure stack already chosen and working.

signals.quote: matching built into the validator client itself (BulkBFT) - 5-20ms fills
signals.counter: Matching inside their own validator client suggests they self-host the critical path and may buy nothing.

signals.quote: assigns a dedicated Solana blockchain address to every Cash App user, enabling them to interact directly with the onchain economy
signals.verified: SEARCH ONLY - secondary coverage, not a Block-owned page
signals.counter: Block is large enough to run its own infrastructure, and an address per user is a wallet feature, not evidence of a vendor decision.

signals.quote: launched SoFiUSD on Solana as the first time a U.S. national bank-issued stablecoin has been available directly within a banking app
signals.counter: A regulated bank will have procurement and vendor-risk processes that a Solana-native pitch does not survive unprepared.

signals.quote: $1m strategic round led by Solana Ventures, earmarked for expanding Hylo leverage and yield infrastructure on Solana
signals.counter: A $1m round rarely funds paid infrastructure; free tiers usually carry a protocol this size.

signals.quote: $2 million strategic round for borrowing against tokenized stocks
signals.counter: Tokenised-equity lending implies liquidations, but nothing read says Spout runs the keepers itself.

signals.quote: institutional capital markets firm developing multi-asset trading services, raised $11 million Seed led by Polychain Capital
signals.verified: SEARCH ONLY - and the CHAIN IS NOT CONFIRMED as Solana
signals.counter: Nothing read confirms Solana. A freshly funded institutional trading firm on another chain is not a Helius lead at all.

signals.quote: brings Apple, Nvidia and Tesla to Solana with NYSE trading in the works
signals.counter: Multi-chain issuer - the Solana workload is a share of the total and may not justify dedicated infrastructure.
